skill.name: character-development-assistant
skill.description: Creates detailed character profiles including backstory, personality traits, motivations, relationships, and character arcs. Use when the user needs help developing compelling, multi-dimensional characters for their story.
skill.summary: Builds structured fiction character profiles with backstory, motives, relationships, and arcs.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

content.value_statement: Flat characters weaken plots and make scenes feel unearned. This skill builds profiles with motives, flaws, relationships, and arcs for stronger fiction.
actual_capabilities: Collects core character details before building a profile.
Defines appearance, mannerisms, speech patterns, strengths, and flaws.
Maps relationships with conflict points and growth opportunities.
Builds backstory events that explain current behavior.
Plans beginning, transformation, ending, and arc type.
Adds writer notes and a validation checklist.
limitations: Does not write full chapters or scenes by itself.
Needs genre and role details for best results.
Uses personality frameworks as creative prompts, not diagnosis.
Does not replace sensitivity review for identity or trauma details.

use_cases.title: Draft a New Protagonist
use_cases.description: Create a full profile for a main character before outlining scenes.

use_cases.title: Deepen a Supporting Cast Member
use_cases.description: Give side characters goals, flaws, and relationships that affect the plot.

use_cases.title: Repair a Flat Character Arc
use_cases.description: Identify weak motives, unclear stakes, and missing transformation points.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Character Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a character profile for a fantasy protagonist named Mira. She is a young healer hiding a dangerous secret. Ask me any missing questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Deepen an Existing Character
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve my supporting character for a contemporary romance. He gives wise advice but avoids his own relationships. Add flaws, goals, and a subplot.

prompt_templates.title: Map Relationships and Arc
prompt_templates.prompt: Build relationships for my protagonist, rival, mentor, and sibling. Show conflict points, growth opportunities, and how each relationship changes the arc.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Character Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this character concept for contradictions, weak motives, and missing stakes. Then revise the profile while preserving the original genre and role.

output_examples.input: A young mage discovers forbidden magic.
output_examples.output: A structured profile for Elara Thorne with a visible secret, Academy pressure, dark magic fear, mentor conflict, and a positive self-acceptance arc.

output_examples.input: A therapist best friend in a contemporary romance.
output_examples.output: A supporting profile for Marcus Chen with advice-giving strengths, commitment fears, family backstory, romantic subplot, and growth through vulnerability.

output_examples.input: My character feels flat and only reacts to the plot.
output: Add a false belief that drives choices.
Give each relationship a clear conflict point.
Tie the final decision to a visible internal change.

best_practices: Provide genre, role, and plot function before asking for a full profile.
Use the validation checklist to test goals, flaws, relationships, and arc.
Revise sensitive backstory details with care and added context.
anti_patterns: Asking for a profile with no role, genre, or story function.
Treating personality frameworks as fixed diagnoses instead of writing prompts.
Adding trauma, secrets, or flaws that never affect the plot.

faq.question: Can this skill create a character from a simple idea?
faq.answer: Yes. It can start from a short concept and ask for missing story details.

faq.question: Does it support different genres?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions mention fantasy, science fiction, contemporary, historical, and other story genres.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing character?
faq.answer: Yes. It can deepen flaws, motives, relationships, backstory, and arc structure.

faq.question: Will it write scenes or dialogue?
faq.answer: It focuses on profiles and planning. It may include sample speech patterns, but not full scenes.

faq.question: Can it handle relationship dynamics?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps relationship type, dynamic, conflict points, and growth opportunities.

faq.question: Is it useful for games or screenplays?
faq.answer: Yes. Any story format with characters, motives, and arcs can use the structure.
